entries.note: The shop made the guide; Veloces has not collected the parcel yet.
Collected from the shop, before the origin warehouse.
Received at the origin warehouse; the first scan when no collection is logged.
Logged when the parcel leaves a warehouse, before each delivery attempt too.
At the destination warehouse; the tracker shows it once per delivery attempt.
With the courier; each one opens a new delivery attempt.
The courier's report of an attempt that did not deliver, logged with a reason from Veloces' list, such as 'No hay quien reciba.' or 'Pedido cancelado.', which the adapter appends.
Back at the warehouse after a failed attempt, waiting for the incident to be solved: a new attempt or a return followed.
The return to the shop has started.
Back with the shop; a final status.
Label the tracking widget on veloces.app shows for the guide's first status.
Label the tracking widget on veloces.app shows while the parcel is in a Veloces warehouse.
Label the tracking widget on veloces.app shows for a national route between cities.
Label the tracking widget on veloces.app shows for a status named in transit.
Label the tracking widget on veloces.app shows, with a motorcycle icon, for the last leg to the recipient.
Label the tracking widget on veloces.app shows for a return.
Label the tracking widget on veloces.app shows while the return is on its way back.
